Chemistry 2019-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2019-I.question: In which of the following functional group isomerism is not possible?
Chemistry 2019-I.explanation: (c)  Alkyl halides do not show functional isomerism. Alcohols and ethers; aldehydes and ketones; cyanides and isocyanides are functional isomers. It is because there's only one way to attach a halogen to a carbon chain: via one single bond. Halogens can't form more than one bond in the context of common organic compounds, and can't form multiple bonds to carbon.

Chemistry 2019-I.question: Which one of the following statements is not correct?
options: Fishcher projection represents the molecule in an eclipsed conformation.
Newman projection can be represented in aneclipsed, staggered and skew conformations.
Fischer projection of the molecule is its most stable conformation.
In Sawhorse projections, the lines are inclined at an angle of 120° to each other.
Chemistry 2019-I.answer: Fischer projection of the molecule is its most stable conformation.
Chemistry 2019-I.explanation: (c)  The most stable conformation of a molecule is in the form of a Newman Projection.

Chemistry 2019-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2019-I.question: Two identical solid pieces, one of gold and other of silver, when immersed completely in water exhibit equal weights. When weighed in air (given that density of gold is greater than that of silver)
options: the gold piece will weigh more
the silver piece will weigh more
both silver and gold pieces weigh equal
weighing will depend on their masses
Chemistry 2019-I.answer: the silver piece will weigh more
Chemistry 2019-I.explanation: (b)  When the two materials were in the water, the less dense material (silver) occupies a greater volume than the more dense gold. So, it has more up thrust from the water and, although they both show the same weight under water, there is more mass of silver present. Hence, out of the water then, the silver would weigh more than the gold.
